feedback.feedback: The map is useful visually, but distance-based cost alone does not identify the economic breakpoint for serving customers.
feedback.direction: Develop storage-to-customer delivered-cost and margin analysis to identify an affordable logistics threshold and competitive route crossover.
feedback.status: Both tests specified on page; numerical thresholds unresolved
feedback.implementation_note: Distinguish customer/supplier delivered economics from Vopak terminal margin. Compare the same product, destination, period and service terms; require acquisition price, handling/storage, route costs, inventory/loss costs, acceptable delivered price or competing offer, and required margin. Do not represent illustrative distance costs as a validated catchment or adopt a new threshold without evidence.
